name: Summer @ SSC (South Shore Conservatory Summer Programs)
activities: Dance (ballet, hip hop, jazz, creative movement)
description_short: South Shore Conservatory's summer arts programs at its Hingham campus (and Duxbury for Summer Dance): week-long morning and full-day camps for young children (Conservatory Kids, Outdoor Explorers, Cooking With Creativity, Dance Discovery) and music weeks for older students (Summer Piano, Summer of Song, Rock Band Jam), each with a showcase or concert at the end of the week.

warnings: The page shows only the 2026 season (June-August 2026), and that summer has already ended. No 2027 dates or programs are posted yet.

There are two campuses with different addresses and phones, so no single address was recorded. Duxbury: The Ellison Center for the Arts, 64 St. George Street, Duxbury, MA 02331, 781-934-2731. Hingham: One Conservatory Drive, Hingham, MA 02043, 781-749-7565.
Conservatory Kids is listed as '5 weeks' but the date range 6/8-7/31 covers about 8 weeks. Which weeks it meets is unclear.
Outdoor Explorers Week 1 is listed as '6/8 - 6/13, ages 4-6 pm'. The text looks garbled, so the hours are unclear and 6/13 is a Saturday.
This is a landing page for a set of separate arts programs, not a single general camp. Most programs have no dates on this page.
8 sessions without full dates were left out
